$comment: The line between looking and acting, in one place.
Read-only subcommands run without a prompt so an agent can survey freely.
exec, start, push, pull, stop and anything with --write are absent on purpose:
they change something on the far side, or land files here, and each one should
surface. guard.py already refuses destructive commands without --write; this is
the second half of the same idea, at the point where the command is issued.
